responsibility: Implements the C/C++ front-end integration for S/390-specific language extensions and intrinsics. It handles vector keyword expansion and zvector parsing hooks, publishes CPU/feature preprocessor builtins, constructs and resolves overloaded intrinsic calls from the tables in s390-builtins.def and s390-builtin-types.def, validates target-feature requirements and immediate operands, and registers S/390 target pragmas and target-option parsing hooks for the front end.
